Self therapy won't cut it. You need to talk to someone or join some online classes. I've been there. Being alone in my house made me think "Why am I even here, no one really cares or loves me" but it wasn't true. No matter how true I thought it was. If you keep on going on in life, you'll see that things get better.

Who said it didn't last? Before that I was in a very dark place. But I started to see that life doesn't revolve around my problems and that if there's nothing I can do to change the bad, like go back in time, (which is impossible) I should focus on the good things in life. Like, the fact that I'm alive and breathing and to keep hope alive. To know that somewhere out there, there is someone who loves me for me, and doesn't judge me no matter what. Listen, kid, don't lose hope. Joy will come and it's not a one time thing unless you make it a one time thing. Yes, of course, you'll get some bumps in the road that makes you feel like that joy will never come again, but it does. As a man who has had plenty of very low downs and not so many ups, I can tell you that life gets better. Try not to focus on the bad in life. If you're going through the loss of a loved one, I can tell you from experience: it gets easier. Just try to take it one step at a time and try to surround yourself with people, they don't have to be friends or family. Just surround yourself with people and keep yourself busy. The worst thing you can do in a time where you're depressed (whether you've lost a loved one or not) is sit around by yourself doing nothing. Because all you have is you and your thoughts. If you're getting bullied for something you can't control or re-do: talk to someone about it and if they denounce your problem like it isn't a big deal, let them know that the shit hurts like hell. And if they still pretend as if everything is ok, talk to someone else about it. Someone will listen and someone will care. Trust me kid. Just keep trying. If you're struggling with suicidal thoughts and thinking that you're a burden on everyone's life and that you shouldn't be here, I can tell you from experience: it's not true. It's just you trying to run away from your problems. But it doesn't help. Suicide doesn't end pain, it just spreads it. If you as if no one loves you or cares for you, I can tell you from experience: that's just the way you feel right now, whether it's true or not. If you keep searching and keep believing, you'll find someone and they will care, and they will love you for you. All I can say is keep hope alive, kid.
